title: Belrose Trade-In and Upgrade Programmes — Appraisal Fee and Revaluation Tariff
content:
The appraisal side publishes, for each of the Belrose Trade-In and Upgrade Programmes, whether a formal appraisal must be on file before credit is issued, what the appraisal costs, whether that fee is credited against the upgrade when the customer goes ahead, how long an appraisal stays good as the basis of a credit, and whether and for how long an issued credit may be revalued.

## Tariff

| Programme | Appraisal required before credit | Appraisal fee (USD) | Fee credited against the upgrade | Appraisal good as a basis for (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Belrose Standard Trade-In | no | 0 | no | 180 |
| Diamond Trade-Up Guarantee | yes | 125 | yes | 365 |
| Bridal Upgrade Guarantee | yes | 125 | yes | 365 |
| Lifetime Diamond Upgrade Guarantee | yes | 175 | yes | 365 |
| Signature Collection Upgrade Privilege | yes | 350 | yes | 180 |
| Estate Purchase and Consignment Programme | yes | 275 | no | 180 |

## Revaluation

| Programme | Issued credit may be revalued | Revaluation window after issue (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|
| Belrose Standard Trade-In | no | 0 |
| Diamond Trade-Up Guarantee | yes | 60 |
| Bridal Upgrade Guarantee | yes | 90 |
| Lifetime Diamond Upgrade Guarantee | yes | 180 |
| Signature Collection Upgrade Privilege | yes | 180 |
| Estate Purchase and Consignment Programme | yes | 60 |

## Questions the tariff answers

**Is an appraisal fee always credited back when the customer upgrades?** No. It is credited against the upgrade under the Diamond Trade-Up Guarantee, the Bridal Upgrade Guarantee, the Lifetime Diamond Upgrade Guarantee and the Signature Collection Upgrade Privilege, and kept under the Estate Purchase and Consignment Programme. The Belrose Standard Trade-In requires no appraisal and charges no fee.

**How long is an appraisal good for?** 365 calendar days under the Diamond Trade-Up Guarantee, the Bridal Upgrade Guarantee and the Lifetime Diamond Upgrade Guarantee; 180 calendar days under the Belrose Standard Trade-In, the Signature Collection Upgrade Privilege and the Estate Purchase and Consignment Programme.

**Which programme has the longest revaluation window?** The Lifetime Diamond Upgrade Guarantee and the Signature Collection Upgrade Privilege, at 180 calendar days each. The Belrose Standard Trade-In does not revalue an issued credit at all, and its window is published as 0.
